review_reference: Owner decisions in chat by D-Eminence, relayed by the coordinator, for 0122 (collect the sign-up fields): "don't remove them instead we need to collect those information" and "allow trading name, all fields required". Every field of facility sign-up, the setup wizard and staff patient registration is required (Identity's DTOs refuse a request without one), except the three document uploads (operating licence, CAC certificate, proof of address) and the facility logo, which stay deferred until the document bucket and its scanner exist. The other decisions take the plan's recommended defaults: D1 CAC legal name kept, trading name collected; D2 the directory keeps the registered address; D3 E.164 8-15 digits, facility_alert_phones not seeded; D4 Medical Director name and MDCN collected, the applicant's phone stored encrypted; D6 state from the 37, LGA free text required; D7 departments a fixed code list; D8 the facility administrator edits after activation at self-service facilities; D9 sealed demo facilities refused; D10 the desk's patient phone and address facility-held, unverified, encrypted; D11 allergies not collected at the desk; D12 provisional local identity off; D13 a stated Health ID is a review candidate (score 65, stated_hid), a verified NIN match wins. UNSIGNED: reviewed_by stays empty until the owner signs.
evidence: Single migration 0122_collect_signup_fields.sql. WHAT IT DOES: new tables identity.nigeria_states (37 rows), identity.facility_profiles and identity.patient_facility_contacts (forced row-level security); four nullable columns on identity.registration_cases (contact ciphertexts, key version, stated Health ID), unchangeable after insert; a new 11-argument identity.begin_self_service_provider_enrollment beside 0086's 7-argument one (unchanged, still granted); an AFTER UPDATE OF status trigger on identity.organization_applications that copies the confirmed code's profile to the facility on approval (self-service activation and administrator approval); identity.read_facility_profile() and identity.set_facility_profile(bigint,jsonb,text,char) (workforce.manage, self-service facility, If-Match, Idempotency-Key, audit with field names only). No existing function body, policy or grant is replaced. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: every new column is nullable; today's Identity calls the 7-argument command and never reads the new objects. PROOF: applied on a fresh Postgres 16 database after 0001-0108, runtime roles bootstrapped, the new suite services/ehr-api/test/database/collect-signup-fields.integration.sql and all 81 other DB suites pass.
